author: Inside Edition
description: Sergio Reyna of Dallas, Texas, shares his story of survival after suffering burns to more than 65 percent of his body. The accident happened in 2001, when he was just two years old. Since then, he has undergone more than 170 surgeries and procedures, with additional treatments still ahead. Through social media, he uses humor and honesty to share his journey and advocate for other burn survivors navigating their new normal.
title: Texas Man Survives Childhood Fire That Burned 65% of His Body
